lessons.trigger_condition: V412 safely added six TCGs, but purchase-availability coverage and dashboard experience validation still contained Pokémon/ONE PIECE/NARUTO assumptions. Current verified 2026 market and official-product evidence also supports Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh! and Digimon Card Game as promoted market categories, while Flesh and Blood, Weiß Schwarz, Cardfight!! Vanguard and hololive OCG should remain watch-only until the configured promotion gates are satisfied.
lessons.prevention_rule: Drive tablet market, release, promo and purchase category coverage from the validated declarative registry. Promote only verified categories meeting official, independent-market, depth and activation thresholds; keep sub-threshold candidates watch-only. Preserve core grading calibration isolation, 17→12→18 screen-neural governance, no user-behavior training, no market-direction prediction, no runtime source rewrite and no Git/main self-write.
validation_required: Magic: The Gathering Yu-Gi-Oh! and Digimon Card Game are promoted with market release promo purchase enabled and grading disabled
Flesh and Blood TCG Weiß Schwarz Cardfight!! Vanguard and hololive OFFICIAL CARD GAME remain watch-only at seed
purchase availability game coverage derives from promoted registry games instead of fixed three-game tokens
dashboard experience validation accepts every declared allowed game score instead of hardcoded three-game scores
registry-provided Korean labels are used for dynamic market-lens chips when available
core Pokémon ONE PIECE NARUTO remain preserved and grading-enabled
new-game grading remains false until separate calibration
mandatory collection job count remains exactly 8
screen neural remains exactly 17 inputs 12 hidden units and 18 allowlisted outputs
profit guarantee investment-return prediction and market-direction prediction remain false
runtime source generation arbitrary commands Git/main writes and verification bypass remain forbidden
physical tablet runtime remains unverified until device-side evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V413 expands verified declarative market categories and removes remaining core-three UI/purchase assumptions. It does not guarantee profit, predict future prices, auto-enable grading for uncalibrated games, execute arbitrary generated code, rewrite runtime source autonomously, write Git/main, or treat repository tests as proof of physical Lenovo execution.
